name: Narrow beam loses the cheap route (DC beam search)
note: Run Divide and Conquer Beam Search. With w = 1 the beam keeps one node per layer and ends with a path of cost 6; with w = 2 (or more) it keeps the cheap route and returns the optimum, cost 4 (UCS agrees). Watch the CUT BY WIDTH list: nodes cut by the beam are gone for good, and the relay in the middle layer lets the path be rebuilt without parent pointers.
